left.title: Alete Neh Anbaye
left.description: This mezmur is a deep prayer of humility and repentance, addressing God as the believer’s rock, strength, and refuge. It expresses dependence on God for stability in the midst of life’s uncertainties and struggles. The chant reflects awareness of personal weakness, fear of falling into sin, and the need for God’s mercy to remain steadfast. It also acknowledges past mistakes, especially judging others, and asks God to renew the heart toward goodness. Overall, it is a sincere plea for guidance, repentance, and spiritual firmness in God.

right.description:

Graphics by: @DeaconFitsumWegene 



Say you’ve forgiven me for Virgin Mary’s sake(2)
Merciful savior of the world no one forgives like you

ምሬሃለዉ በለኝ ስል ድንግል ማርያም /2
ምሃሪው መድኃኒ አለም ይቅር ባይ እንዳንተ የለም

Long enough I have stayed within the tents of sin
Renew my heart and spirts righteousness within
With your merciful eyes my lord look upon me
For the sake of the Virgin Mary set me free(2)

Lightly I took the significance of your blood
Retreated to my home from jaws of destruction
Shattered and restless I have been without your peace
For your dear mothers sake I plead for your mercy
For Virgin Mary sake I plead for your mercy

My vain desire caused my flesh to bury my soul
I have lost all my strength and broken all my bones
Purify me my lord even whiter than snow
For Virgin Mary’s sake cleanse the sin from my soul(2)

Open my mouth so I may rise in thanksgiving.
What’s guarding me from you expel the walls from me
Clothe me in righteousness I’m through with being cold
For virgin Mary’s sake return me to my home(2)

left.title: Yesmu Tirgwame
left.description: This mezmur praises Saint Michael the Archangel, whose name means 'Who is like God.' It highlights his role as a powerful intercessor who connects humanity to God and protects the faithful. The chant recalls biblical events such as the deliverance of Daniel, emphasizing Michael’s strength and divine assistance. It also reflects personal testimony, showing how God works through Michael to uplift and bless believers. Ultimately, it is a song of gratitude and trust, glorifying God for His help through the Archangel Michael.

left.title: Imebete Yeamlak Inat
left.description: This mezmur is a heartfelt praise to the Virgin Mary, honoring her as the Mother of God and the Queen of heaven and earth. It expresses a desire to continually glorify her and her Son, recognizing her humility, purity, and chosen role as the dwelling place of God. The chant also reflects deep reliance on her intercession, asking her to guide and protect believers through trials and lead them safely through spiritual struggles. It emphasizes devotion, humility, and trust in her motherly care.

right.title: Imebete Yeamlak Inat
right.description:
Original Song: Emebete Ye-Amlak Enat
Original Singer: Liqe Mezemeran Tewodros Yosef

Mother of God Virgin Mary
Day and night I will sing to thee
Your blessed son I'll glorify
Worship is due to The Most High
           
My heart it will arise tuned for praise I will sing
Through my humility I give my offering 
Zion you are near me Abraham's holy tent
Mother of shining light it’s you I lean against

O Green Meadow of Peace the one He had chosen
Ark of the covenant you're Isaiah's virgin
Queen of heaven and Earth standing on the Lord's right
Honor is due to her we will sing day and night

Dearest Virgin Mary the mother of us all
With your intercession save me so I don't fall
Help me cross through the flames keep me on the right path
Death and defeat will cease since I have you at last
